captions.detailed: This is a counterbalance drafting floor lamp with a heavy black cylindrical base and a tall, slender silver post. At the top of the post is a black pivot block holding a horizontal silver boom arm, which has a cylindrical bronze-colored counterweight on one end and a conical light shade on the other. The boom arm pivots on a revolute joint about a horizontal axis, and the white conical shade rotates on a revolute joint about its connection point at the end of the arm.
captions.instruction: Generate a counterbalance drafting floor lamp with a heavy black cylindrical base, a tall silver vertical post, and a horizontal boom arm. The boom arm should feature a bronze-colored cylindrical counterweight on the short end and a white conical lamp shade on the long end, with revolute joints enabling the boom to tilt vertically and the shade to rotate.
captions.factory: The code constructs the lamp in three main parts: the base, the boom, and the shade. The base part is built using a thick cylinder for the floor stand and a tall cylinder for the vertical post, topped with a box for the pivot block. The boom part is created with a long horizontal cylinder for the arm and a shorter, thicker cylinder representing the counterweight. The shade part is constructed using a truncated cone (or lofted circles) for the conical shade, complete with a small cylindrical connector. Finally, two revolute joints are defined: one connecting the base to the boom for vertical tilting, and another connecting the boom to the shade for rotation.
